page.body:
## Context
Northwind Robotics (fictional) builds warehouse picking robots: about 240 people, Series B.

## Talking points
- Operator dashboards and incident review look like the pain point.
- Ask early whether ops or the platform team owns tooling.

## Goal for the call
Agree on a two-week pilot with one warehouse team.
